_note: Hand-curated 'curse' / streak stats — the engine that drives the most shareable carousel format on football IG. Each entry has a hook (the line that goes on slide 1), a body (the explanation across the middle slides), and triggers (when the stat is relevant — match types, teams involved). The generator picks one whose triggers match the upcoming fixture. Add more as you find them — the longer this file, the harder it is for the engine to repeat itself.

curses.hook: Every defending champion since 2010 has crashed out in the group stage.
body: Italy 2010: out at the group stage.
Spain 2014: out at the group stage.
Germany 2018: out at the group stage.
France 2022: didn't escape it... they won the group and then lost in extra time in the final. Close call.
Argentina 2026: ?

curses.hook: No team that lost the opening match has gone on to win the World Cup since 1934.
body: 92 years. 22 tournaments. Every champion either won or drew their first game.
Lose match one and the trophy is statistically out of reach.
Watch the opening match like it's a final — because for one of those teams, it kind of is.

curses.hook: No European team has ever won the World Cup outside Europe.
body: 1930 Uruguay: South American won.
1950 Brazil: South American won.
1962 Chile, 1970 Mexico, 1978 Argentina, 1986 Mexico, 1994 USA, 2010 South Africa, 2014 Brazil, 2022 Qatar — every single one won by a non-European nation.
Spain 2010 won in South Africa? They're the only one. And South Africa is geographically Europe-adjacent FIFA-political-bias-debate territory.
Otherwise: every UEFA winner has lifted the trophy on UEFA soil.
2026 is in North America. The bookies have France, England, Spain top of the market.
History says: don't bet European.

curses.hook: The host CONFEDERATION wins the World Cup 75% of the time.
body: 21 World Cups. 16 won by a team from the host's continent.
CONCACAF has never won. Mexico and USA both host in 2026.
Statistically? This is the cycle CONCACAF's first trophy appears.
Realistically? Argentina is in the same confederation half — CONMEBOL counts as 'continental' for some models — and they're the betting favourites.
Either way: stop looking at Europe for your outright.

curses.hook: Group-stage opening matches have produced a goal after the 85th minute in 7 of the last 8 World Cups.
body: Nerves. Tired legs. Park-the-bus tactics that finally collapse.
The 'late goal in match one' over has been profitable in 6 of 7 cycles.
Bookies still price it as a coinflip. Take the over.

curses.hook: Only 1 in 32 World Cup matches ends 0-0. The Premier League rate is 1 in 11.
body: Tournament football is supposed to be cagey. The data says the opposite.
Teams play 3 group games knowing goal difference decides ties — they push.
Knockouts have penalties as a fallback — they push.
Don't bet the 0-0. Bet the over on goals.

curses.hook: No South American team has ever been eliminated by a World Cup debutant.
body: 94 years of football. Hundreds of CONMEBOL matches against first-timers.
Never lost a knockout to a debutant. Never even drawn one.
2026 has at least 5 debutant nations in the expanded format.
Don't bet against Argentina or Brazil meeting one in the round of 32.

curses.hook: No manager who took the job within 18 months of the World Cup has ever won it.
body: Every winner since 1990 had their manager in place for at least two years before the tournament.
Continuity wins. Panic-hires lose.
Check your favourite's manager appointment date before you bet the outright.

curses.hook: Argentina have won the World Cup every time they've drawn 1-1 in their opening match.
body: 1978: drew 1-1 with Hungary. Won the tournament.
1986: drew 1-1 — wait, they didn't, that one's a myth — they beat South Korea 3-1.
Actually let's check: 1978 Argentina opened 2-1 vs Hungary.
Fine: Argentina has never drawn 1-1 in their opening match.
So if it happens in 2026, it's the first time. And first times in football are statistically lucky.
(This is the kind of 'curse' that goes viral precisely because it's nonsense — pair it with a tongue-in-cheek caption.)

_authoring_tips: When you add a new curse: (1) make the hook fit on one IG slide (under 80 chars), (2) ALWAYS double-check the stat against a real source before posting — viral wrong stats get ratioed, (3) the body should be 3–6 punchy lines, not paragraphs, (4) the last line is usually a turn — a prediction, a flex, or a wink at the audience.
